meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把问题交给一个模拟的「意识委员会」:先选出 4-6 个不同思维原型(如建筑师、逆向者、经验主义者等)各自发言,再综合成一份包含共识、核心张力、盲点、建议路径和置信度的报告。
howto.when: 当用户需要多角度思考、做艰难决定、要求委员会/小组讨论,或说“council mode”“mind council”等触发词,以及面临两难或复杂选择时触发。

say.text: 帮我用委员会模式分析:该不该辞职创业?
say.note: 触发完整三阶段审议,得到多视角报告。

say.text: 快速审议一下:选 A 还是 B 方案?
来一场深度审议:如何设计这个系统架构?
say.note: 触发 deep council,6 位成员,推理更详细。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude runs a simulated 'Mind Council': it picks 4-6 thinking archetypes, lets each state a position, reasoning, risks, and insights, then delivers a synthesis covering convergence, core tension, blind spot, recommended path, and confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants diverse viewpoints, faces a hard decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, says trigger phrases like 'council mode' or 'mind council', or hits a dilemma with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Run a council on whether I should quit my job to start a company.
Quick council: option A or option B?
say_en.note: Triggers quick mode with 3 members and shorter replies.

say_en.text: Deep council on how to design this system architecture.
say_en.note: Triggers deep mode with 6 members and extended reasoning.
